cross_verification.note_en: The Embassy of Haiti (haiti.org) visa page -- covering both tourist and diplomatic/official visas, published in English, French, and Haitian Creole -- was fetched directly and states only 'Two (2) color passport photos,' with no size, background, or composition detail specified for the visa category. The sister passport-application page on the same domain separately states a white background and a 3-month currency window (see ht-passport.json), but since the visa page itself does not restate those figures, they are not carried over by inference and are left unverified per the truthfulness gate.
